reason: I choose my own vegetables, fruit and meat, I don't let anyone pick for me. And I already have my tab at the dekkene, so paying $2 extra on top of groceries makes no sense when every dollar counts.
objection: A stranger picking my tomatoes and my meat, and then I pay a fee on top for it. I'd never know if they gave me the good ones.
would_change_my_mind: If I could pick my own fresh produce and meat at pickup before paying, or if the fee were waived for me and the shopper was someone I know from the village.
